text: わしは　あの　ニュースが　みたくて　カラーテレビを　かったんじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb stem says you want to do it; くて links it to the next part as the reason. みたくて = 'wanting to watch, so'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んじゃ is an old-man form of んだ, used to explain or stress a reason. かったんじゃ = 'it's that I bought (it)'.
